subject: general
question: Which of the following ranges separates the Kashmir Valley from the rest of the Himalayan region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pir Panjal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pir Panjal Range** is the largest range of the **Lesser Himalayas (Himachal)**.
 
• It forms the **southern boundary of the Kashmir Valley** and separates it from the **Jammu region and the rest of the Himalayan region**.
 
• The famous **Banihal Pass** lies in the Pir Panjal Range and provides an important route connecting the Kashmir Valley with Jammu.
 
• The **Pir Panjal Tunnel (Banihal-Qazigund Road Tunnel)** and the **Pir Panjal Railway Tunnel** are major transport links through this range.
 
• Hence, the **Pir Panjal Range** separates the Kashmir Valley from the rest of the Himalayan region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Zaskar Range:**

 
 
• Located to the **east of the Kashmir Valley**.
 
• Separates the Kashmir Valley from the Indus Valley in Ladakh.
 
 
 
• **Karakoram Range:**
 
 
• Located in the northernmost part of the Trans-Himalayas.
 
• Home to **K2 (Mount Godwin-Austen)**, the world's second-highest peak.
 
 
 
• **Ladakh Range:**
 
 
• Situated between the **Karakoram Range** and the **Zaskar Range**.
 
• Forms part of the **Trans-Himalayan** mountain system.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Pir Panjal Range** is the largest range of the Lesser Himalayas.
 
• It separates the **Kashmir Valley** from the **Jammu Plain and the rest of the Himalayan region**.
 
• **Banihal Pass** and the **Pir Panjal Tunnel** are important features of this range.
 
• **Zaskar, Ladakh, and Karakoram** are part of the higher Himalayan and Trans-Himalayan systems.
